notes: Third provider of the `decide` inference type: Juspay's open-weights XOR, reached at a configured base URL (an XOR deployment or a LiteLLM pass-through route); it has no built-in endpoint, so XOR_BASE_URL or credentials.xor.baseURL is required. Tier 3 for the same reasons as typesafe and laya (the catalog schema has no decide vocabulary and requires output-token fields). Extends SystemOneDecisionProvider. Declares inferenceKinds ["decide"] and decisionLimits, and sits after laya in HAND_DESCRIPTORS so typesafe and laya stay the default whenever their keys are set. Also accepts images and one video through DecisionRequest.
